text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Kgh...!
I was just one step away...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was so strong!
They must have put in grueling, blood-and-sweat effort...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
That's why... I have to work
even harder than they do.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: So that I can see the view from the top...!
choice_data_list: Let's not rush—let's just keep doing things the way we have been.
Alright, special training so we can win!
Alright, time for special training so we can win!

text_block_list.text: So that I can see the view from the top...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer!
I almost lost sight of my own pace there.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
At my—... No, at our own stride!
Let's keep growing steadily together!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
No matter the special training, I'll overcome it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Even if it is a path of thorns, a path exists nonetheless.
Then—all that's left is to charge up it!
